description: This PHP class 'Doctrine' manages the setup and configuration of Doctrine ORM within the OrangeHRM system, including entity manager creation, cache configuration, and type mappings.

classes.name: Doctrine
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for configuring and providing access to Doctrine ORM's EntityManager, including cache setup, proxy configuration, and custom functions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes Doctrine ORM configuration, including cache, proxy settings, and database connection parameters.

methods.name: isDevMode
methods.description: Determines if the application is running in development mode by checking the debug status of the HTTP kernel.

methods.name: getPaths
methods.description: Retrieves entity paths from plugin directories for ORM configuration.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides the singleton instance of the Doctrine class.

methods.name: getEntityManager
methods.description: Returns the Doctrine EntityManager instance for database operations.
